## Entry checklist (delete rows that don't apply)

- [ ] Every catalogued item obeys the **Prime Rule** — real, done by someone in earnest at scale.
- [ ] Items grouped under the axes from `axes.md`, in canonical order (inapplicable axes omitted, not reordered).
- [ ] Each item tagged with **Effort** `[low|med|high]` and **Bit-factor** `[⚖️|🎭]`.
- [ ] Entry is narratively self-contained (no dependence on other entries).
- [ ] Ends with the **Coda** — the sincere, high-leverage subset.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/lint-entries.py` passes locally.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
